title: [Main]- Mismatch between Purchase Invoice Total in Lines and Statistics after VAT adjustment
summary: Purchase invoice line totals now correctly reflect manual VAT adjustments from the statistics page when using mixed VAT groups, fixing a mismatch issue by recalculating grouped VAT amounts.
key_points: VAT totals on purchase invoice subforms now update when manual VAT adjustments are made from the statistics page
Grouped VAT recalculation is triggered only when VAT differences exist on the invoice lines
Fixes mismatch between line totals and statistics totals when mixed VAT groups are used
Changes applied across all localization layers (Base Application, North America, Belgium)
